title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope — Episode4 A Million Views?!

meta.Event Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
Get a chance to check out the Yuporin dance?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I did!
The song's super cute too, right?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sounds pretty lively today...
I wonder what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Can I ask what you were talking about just now?

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: I just learned about it just now, but everyone started doing this thing called the “Yuporin dance” a few days ago.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yuporin...? Oh, you mean that really famous streamer? They're on TrickTrick or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Here, check out this dance!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The song they're dancing to... Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This morning... I saw this dance...! Th-The song, it's...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I had a feeling...
This song...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's so bright and cheerful too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a little rough around the edges, but it's a great song! And it suits us so well as a group!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I knew it! She's so amazing!
I can't believe Yuporin's using her song!

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: Wait, you two know who wrote this song?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, but we only met just recently.

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line:
What?! No way!
That means they're gonna be really famous! I mean, Yuporin's using their song!

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: That's like five million followers right there. Imagine what's gonna happen when other people start posting their own content using this song.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hey, let's try the Yuporin dance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if other people all over Japan are already dancing to Hasegawa's song like this? This is so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
But it's so fun, you know?
I was so bummed when I saw my bedhead this morning, but this made me feel a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
It's so addictive too!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: So I decided that I also want to write songs that can give someone hope...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone who listened to Hasegawa's song seems so cheerful and optimistic.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please excuse us for asking to meet so suddenly... But did you two see that video...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
I had a feeling you'd want to discuss that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I still can't believe it!
I suddenly heard someone playing Hasegawa's song and everyone was dancing to it... Look, they're dancing too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose this is the definition of “going viral”...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Based on what I saw, this is turning into Yuporin's most or second most viral dance video!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that explains what's going on here too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The videos Hasegawa originally posted.
The Yuporin dance only uses a part of that song, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This video's getting a ton of views because all these people want to hear the entire song.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Hold on... Ones, tens, hundreds, thousands...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Because it's an incredible song.
I guess this means her wish to “spread hope to her listeners” came true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, wanna try calling her?
We need to congratulate her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'm sure she'll be happy to hear from us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try calling her now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes!
Hasegawa, please allow us to congratulate you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're making it sound like she won the lottery or something.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case... Everyone at our school's been playing your song nonstop, Hasegawa. It's an incredible sight!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <It was only just recently that I gave permission to use this song, but I didn't expect it to blow up like this so fast... My brain still sort of hasn't caught up...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll understand soon enough. Everyone in the comments section's remarking how cute and cheerful your song is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe it's only natural considering how wonderful your song is, Hasegawa.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm wrapping up the demo right now, so it should be ready sometime this week!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great, thank you.
We can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<And I'll keep doing my best!
Oh, break's almost over. Sorry, I need to go...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She seemed kinda flustered but happy at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm just as thrilled for her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do everything we can to make the song she's writing now a huge hit!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That means we're gonna need to come up with a cute dance routine that matches Yuporin's!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I still can't believe it. Everyone all over Japan's listening to my song...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Oh, my video's received so many comments too.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<This song really cheered me up!>
<So cute!>
<Do any karaoke places carry this? I wanna sing it with my friends!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone really seems to be enjoying my song. It's still hard to believe that so many people are listening to it...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I swear I've heard this before somewhere.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, did they copy someone else?>
<Wait, they stole this?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <It's like this song's trying to shove “happiness” down your throat. Hearing this when I'm trying to focus on real problems is the worst.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I know, right?
I didn't want to hear it, but people started blasting it in class because it's popular or whatever. It's awful.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I just wanted to spread hope to others...
